messages:
Mia Chen: Morning — got a burn-rate alert for the /generate SLO last night, notified by slo-monitoring. Alert says burn_rate=2.8 for 15m. Where should I look for the canonical dashboards/traces? The incident link in the alert (incident-1234) doesn't show logs for me.
AJ Patel: The SLO dashboard is the first stop: https://console.redwood.internal/d/slo/production-slos — panel 3 shows burn-rate by route/model. Traces are in Jaeger at https://traces.redwood.internal/jaeger/search (service=inference-runtime).
Mia Chen: thanks — anyone know if this was model-specific or infra-wide?
Karen Gomez: quick scan: errors concentrated on rpool-gpu-europe-2 between ~02:12–02:40 UTC. Seeing lots of gRPC "stream reset" and "deadline exceeded" entries in logs.
Sam Ortiz: note — deploy-bot shows a canary deploy at 01:58 (v2-quant -> rpool-gpu-europe-2). Could be correlated. deploy-bot: "canary 2026-03-05T01:58 deployed v2-quant to rpool-gpu-europe-2"
Mia Chen: can you paste the log query you used?
Karen Gomez: sure, use this quick query in Logs UI:
```
service:runtime AND env:prod AND pool:rpool-gpu-europe-2 AND level:ERROR
| where timestamp >= "2026-03-05T02:00:00Z" and timestamp <= "2026-03-05T03:00:00Z"
| sort by timestamp desc
| limit 500
```
Sam Ortiz: also check KV cache miss rate and connection errors. Cache misses spiked right before the gRPC resets on the same hosts — dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/kv/cache-metrics (panel: cache_miss_rate).
Leo Wang: I adjusted the SLO alert aggregation window from 1m to 10m and added a model-scoped filter to reduce noisy cross-model flaps. Will watch for two hours. :white_check_mark:
Mia Chen: good call. Can someone add a customer-facing blurb to the incident? Support is getting pings.
Sam Ortiz: done — updated incident-1234: "We observed intermittent degraded latency for inference requests in EU region between 02:12–02:40 UTC. Engineers mitigated and are monitoring." :memo:
Mia Chen: owners for the /generate SLO are @Karen Gomez and @Leo Wang — please schedule a short postmortem and propose alert tuning (thresholds, aggregation, and optional model filters).
Karen Gomez: will draft a 1-page summary and upload to #postmortems by EOD.
deploy-bot: Canary note: no rollback executed; canary flagged for manual verification.
ops-bot: Reconciled alert state: closed at 1769004320.
Mia Chen: thanks all — closing the thread for now. If new evidence shows it's ongoing, I'll reopen in #incidents.
